confirmed.title: Confirmed
confirmed.description: False when read from words in the question: no suggestion until the user confirms by sending the amount as budget_iqd

budget_iqd.title: Budget Iqd
budget_iqd.description: Wins over any amount written in the question

engine.title: Engine
engine.description: llm = worded by the model; rules = rule-based answer

answer.title: Answer
answer.description: Plain Arabic text, no markdown and no dashes

show_figures.title: Show Figures
show_figures.description: The question is about prices, money, the budget or holdings: show the figures (market_snapshot, budget, holdings_grams) in their own panel under the answer

budget.description: null when no budget was given or found

suggestions.title: Suggestions
suggestions.description: From the rule-based matcher (same as /api/ai/match), never from the model

follow_up_questions.title: Follow Up Questions
follow_up_questions.description: Up to 3 questions to offer next, fitted to this question (checked like the answer; rule-based ones when the model is not used)

status.description: Only 'cancelled' can be set by the investor

message.title: Message
message.description: Same reply for a new or a repeated signup

ListingCreateIn.title: ListingCreateIn
ListingCreateIn.description: The price is computed server-side from the live 24K price; any price field is ignored.

seller_name.title: Seller Name
seller_name.description: The seller's name; for an investor resale a neutral label, never the name

listing_type.description: seller_listing, or investor_resale (show 'إعادة بيع من مستثمر')

current_price_per_gram.title: Current Price Per Gram
current_price_per_gram.description: Live price for this karat now; the purchase uses this (see preview)

status.title: Status
status.description: Owner can suspend or re-activate. sold_out is set by the system only.

xau_usd_per_ounce.title: Xau Usd Per Ounce
xau_usd_per_ounce.description: Global gold reference, USD per troy ounce

updated_at.title: Updated At
updated_at.description: When this price was fetched from the provider

is_stale.title: Is Stale
is_stale.description: True when the last successful refresh is too old

risk_profile.description: Read from the account, not the request

by_karat.title: By Karat
by_karat.description: Derived from the transaction log; sums to the total

message.title: Message
message.description: Shown when the investor owns nothing

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.default: التوقيع الرقمي إثبات تقني داخلي لسلامة رصيدك داخل منصة صِلة، وليس سند ملكية قانونياً معترفاً به رسمياً.

current_value_iqd.title: Current Value Iqd
current_value_iqd.description: Grams × today's price for each karat

principal_amount.title: Principal Amount
principal_amount.description: What the seller receives in full

price_updated_at.title: Price Updated At
price_updated_at.description: Timestamp of the market price used

risk_insight_note.title: Risk Insight Note
risk_insight_note.description: Shown instead of the insight when AI analysis is unavailable

status.title: Status
status.description: suspended keeps the grams reserved; withdrawn is final and releases them

risk_profile.description: Required for investors; ignored for sellers.

temporary_password.title: Temporary Password
temporary_password.description: Shown once. Give it to the user; they must choose a new one at sign-in.

side.title: Side
side.description: buy: I bought. sell: sold from my listing (seller) or my resale (investor)

is_premium_active.title: Is Premium Active
is_premium_active.description: subscription_expiry_date > now(); use this, not subscription_tier, to gate UI

must_change_password.title: Must Change Password
must_change_password.description: Signed in with a temporary password from an admin: ask for a new one first
